that specializes in Mincecore/Grindcore/Goregrind/Gore/Noise

Black Beer was born in Santo Domingo, Ecuador, after the pandemic, paying tribute to MOTORHEAD.  From there, they embarked on creating new songs inspired by alcohol, violence, and dark rock and roll. Worship of damned fast rock and roll and Satan, inspired by the most street-level rock and roll like Venom, Motorhead, GBH, and Tank. 

Drink and destroy everything!

Lineup:

Sepulcral - vocals and guitar
X - drums
Blastard - bass
Impío – guitar
